text_block_list.name: Skilled Trainer
text_block_list.text:
All right, Air Shakur, do a lap for me<n>using the
strategy I just explained.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
The next day, I've once again come<n>to the training
course to watch the<n>racers. That's when I spot a
trainer<n>talking to Air Shakur.
choice_data_list: (I wonder what sort of run she'll show him...)

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: ...Sigh. Let's do this.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Hrrraugh!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: Eek! N-no way... Let's run<n>somewhere else...

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Air Shakur's run is wilder than I<n>imagined... but it's
not sloppy. In fact,<n>I'd say it's refined to the point
where<n>no inefficiency remains.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Huff, huff, huff! Hahaha!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
As she enters the straightaway, she<n>goes faster
and faster, like she's<n>chasing her prey. I'm
awestruck by<n>the skill on display. She's clearly
talented. However...

text_block_list.name: Skilled Trainer
text_block_list.text: H-hey! What do you think you'redoing? That is not what I told you todo!

text_block_list.name: Skilled Trainer
text_block_list.text:
I told you to try pace chasing for this<n>first lap, so
why did you hold back<n>until the fourth corner?

text_block_list.name: Skilled Trainer
text_block_list.text:
If I'm going to be your trainer, I need<n>to assess
your skills. But I can't do<n>that unless you
cooperate!

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Then don't waste my time.

text_block_list.name: Skilled Trainer
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
You need to see me pace chase to<n>assess my
abilities? Why? What's<n>the logic there?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Not that it matters. I've already<n>collected and
assessed the data<n>myself. I'm not gonna waste
resources on half-baked experiments.

text_block_list.name: Skilled Trainer
text_block_list.text:
But you can't guarantee that the data<n>you've
collected is correct, right? My<n>experience as a
trainer affords me<n>the insight to make—

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Ugh, okay, we're done. You're the<n>same as all the
others, so forget I<n>ever agreed to this training
supervision thing. Leave.

text_block_list.name: Skilled Trainer
text_block_list.text: Huh?! What are you saying?! We<n>just got started!

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: And now we're done. If you try andtake up any more of my precioustime... You know what'll happen,right? Right?!

text_block_list.name: Skilled Trainer
text_block_list.text:
Urk! Wh-what's your problem... Fine,<n>have it your
way!

text_block_list.name: Trainer A
text_block_list.text:
D-did you see that? How the heck<n>are you
supposed to train such an<n>unruly racer?

text_block_list.name: Trainer B
text_block_list.text:
You don't, that's how... Talking to her<n>would be like
talking to a brick wa—

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Hey, if you're gonna whisper, at least<n>do it where I
can't—

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Hwaaah!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Owww... I'm so sorry... Look at me,<n>making you
help me up again...

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Another spectacular fall. What<n>happened this time?

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Ah, um, well... I guess I went a little<n>overboard... My
time hasn't gotten<n>any shorter recently... I suppose
I<n>was running too much...

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
...So you've hit a wall. Instead of<n>tackling it head-on,
wouldn't it be<n>better to try something else?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
I get that you're working hard, but<n>you can only
improve so much. We all<n>have limits. Refusing to
give up will<n>just result in wasted time.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Um, well... I'm not very clever, so any<n>idea I have
would be worthless... All I<n>can do is work hard.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
But I figured that as long as I keep<n>throwing my
whole body into that<n>wall... maybe someday, it'll
finally<n>break? I don't know...

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
...I see. Well, then I guess... I look<n>forward to seeing
you tear down that<n>wall.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: "Someday," huh...

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: What a meaningless wish...

text_block_list.name: Trainer B
text_block_list.text: Phew... Looks like she's calmeddown... That Air Shakur, she waseven worse than usual today.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
She said it rather quietly, but the pain<n>in her voice
echoes through my<n>mind...

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
But so does the image of her run.<n>Later in the
evening, I find myself<n>back at the course, only to
see...

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Huff... Huff... Huff...

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Dammit... nothing changed! Not now,not then, NOT EVER!

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Seven centimeters! That's it! Just a<n>few
centimeters, but no matter how<n>much I try... I can't
even—

Oh my, this isn't like her at all. All that<n>bottled up
frustration is finally spilling<n>out.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Good evening. I am Agnes Tachyon, a<n>friend of
Shakur's... Although I'm<n>sure she'd object to that
statement.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
She's certainly overdoing it today.<n>For someone so
obsessed with<n>efficiency and benefit, seeing her
lashing out so fruitlessly is quite<n>strange.
choice_data_list: Just what is she trying to do?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Do you have much experience with<n>the world of
zeros and ones? If not,<n>I'm afraid you may never
understand<n>her.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
You could say... Shakur is a devout<n>follower of data.
She spends her time<n>collecting it and running
simulations,<n>all in the hopes of finding a solution.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
She sees the world in terms of true<n>and false.
Ambiguities such as<n>potential do not exist for her.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
What you see now... is her god<n>denying her a
prosperous future. And<n>as her god is absolute, that
revelation<n>too remains unchangeable.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
If it did change, that would mean her<n>entire
worldview is wrong—an equally<n>terrifying prospect.
So she has no<n>choice but to accept her fate,
whether<n>she likes it or not.
choice_data_list: But even so, she wants to change something...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Heh, correct you are! Her mind truly is<n>an enigma.
Why does she continue to<n>struggle when she
herself would<n>admit it's futile?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Shakur's vision of the ideal racer is<n>chiseled
perfection... But if you ask<n>me, there is potential to
be found in<n>the discarded scraps and undefined
spaces.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Oh my, it looks like she's finishing up.<n>As much as
she likes observing other<n>runners, she hates to be
the one<n>observed.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: I shall be taking my leave here, butyou... Now that your curiosity hasbeen piqued and Shakur fills your thoughts... What will you do?

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
As if in response to Agnes<n>Tachyon's question, I
turn around<n>and race after Air Shakur.
